content: niri-family packaging CONFIRMED live on BOTH variants: dinit niriWayle flagship 140/140 (niri-base-config r1 + wayle-config 0.1.2: base.kdl include split, portals admin conf, dconf db package-materialized via post-install because the flatpak edge install precedes the desktop setup) + dinit niri DMS 135/135 (shared layer verified, zero dconf-WARNING). niri.go 560->498, niri_wayle.go 869->535, branding.go deleted. Ordering lesson: edge/flatpak install runs BEFORE the desktop setup — package-post-install materialization beats installer-desktop-setup for anything the edge install touches.

Branding split (2026-11-24): feralos-branding 0.1.0 = canonical staging /usr/share/feralos/branding (logo+wallpapers, symlink consumers: niri-base-config 0.2.0 wallpapers, wayle-config 0.1.3 + dms-config 0.1.1 hicolor logo; symlinks = tracked package() content, install -d parents needed). feralos-branding-cli 0.1.0 = os-release/issue/motd takeover (replaces alpine-release+alpine-baselayout; alpine-release file stays vendor; universal standardPackages). Harness: os_identity check. Lesson: abuild forbids /usr/local; packages must install -d parents before ln -s.
